Hi Sara —

Thanks for the note and congrats on getting the POC moving. Short answers up front:
- Yes — we support both card-on-file and monthly invoicing.
- We can offer Net30 terms after a credit review; Net45 is available in select enterprise cases.
- Required items for invoice billing: signed PO with a matching billing contact, company legal name + tax ID, and a completed W-9 (US). Insurance certificates are only required for Dedicated/Private deployments, not a hosted API POC.
- Switching from card to invoice is straightforward; we bill the month after the switch. Card can be used as a fallback if invoice payment is delayed.

If it's helpful I can loop in Sales to send the standard rate card and propose a starter discount for the POC. Also happy to introduce our finance lead to fast-track the credit check.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sara — looping in to share the practical options and a rate card. Attached: redwood-ratecard-2026.pdf (pricing bands & typical volume breakpoints). Two common paths we suggest for POCs:

1) Card on file — fastest to get started, immediate provisioning. No paperwork required.
2) Monthly invoice, Net30 — we generate invoices monthly and payment is due 30 days from invoice date after completing a brief credit review. To enable: signed PO + billing contact + W-9 + tax ID.

We can also do a short-term concession for the POC: 20% off hosted API per-token charges for the first 90 days (applies at the line-item level, not to add-on services). If Acme can commit to a purchase order and standard invoice terms, we can bake that into the initial invoice schedule. If you need an early-payment incentive, we offer 1.5% discount if the invoice is paid within 10 days.

Notes on mechanics:
- Invoices are emailed to the billing contact on file and include PO number for matching.
- If an invoice is late, the card on file (if present) will not be charged automatically without separate authorization — we work with procurement to avoid surprises.
- Taxes handled per billing address; for US customers we ask for tax-exempt certificates where applicable.

I attached the rate card and a sample invoice workflow diagram. HubSpot record linked: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/ACME-789

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Sara / Procurement team —

Quick finance note to make the onboarding as smooth as possible:
- We can enable monthly invoicing with Net30 terms after a standard credit review (usually completes within 2–3 business days once we have the docs below).
- Please provide: billing contact name/email, company legal name, tax ID (EIN), and a signed PO (sample attached: Acme_PO_template.pdf).
- Invoices will be generated on the 1st of each month for the prior month's usage and emailed to the billing contact you specify. Payment instructions and wire/ACH details are on the invoice.
- If you prefer immediate provisioning while the credit review is in progress, supply a card on file as fallback — it will not be charged without notice.

Once procurement sends the PO and billing contact I will start the credit intake. If there are special tax handling requests (resale certificate, nexus considerations), attach those with the PO.

Cheers,
